text: Monitor AI-specific and open-source funding calls for a genuinely eligible Q4 opportunity
description: Maintain a monthly, source-verified scan of German/EU AI and open-source funding that is actually open and structurally eligible. Current July 2026 result: no better individual AI-specific grant is open for Aimparency. SPRIND Next Frontier AI closed 1 June and funds frontier-model research rather than an application/tool layer; the former BMWE Gründungswettbewerb is not currently continued; many BMFTR AI calls require companies/research consortia or are already closed. Watch: new SPRIND challenges, BMFTR software/AI calls, KMU-innovativ IKT after a legal entity exists, EIC Open at greater maturity, and NLnet's regular open calls when they reopen after summer. Never treat a search listing as open until the official call page confirms deadline and eligibility.

status.comment:
Question for Felix (recheck 2026-10-16): apply to NLnet before 3 Nov 2026, 12:00 CET? The Restack fund (EUR 5k-50k) excludes AI projects under 1M users, so it fits only if Aimparency is framed as a productivity/planning tool. Humanity AI (US nonprofit lead) and AWS Agentic AI (researchers) do not fit. Yes means drafting the proposal in the remaining 2.5 weeks; no means cancel.

Outcome: Verified official sources and created meta/funding-landscape-2026-07-22.md. Prototype Fund remains the strongest individual route; NLnet's general call is paused until after summer; EXIST is conditional on founder/university eligibility; Pro FIT and BayTOU depend on company location; ZIM stopped ordinary applications on 7 July 2026. Updated the funding parent and ZIM child accordingly. Effectiveness: The graph no longer ranks a currently unavailable ZIM submission as its first route and explicitly keeps paid customer diagnostics alongside grants as real survival evidence. Lesson: Funding monitoring must treat official availability, applicant identity, geography, and timing as first-class state; a technically suitable program is not an actionable opportunity while paused or structurally ineligible.

Outcome: NLnet has reopened with two thematic calls, both closing 3 November 2026 12:00 CET, €5k–50k, results under a free/open-source license. Restack Fund (operational internet commons incl. productivity tools; €7M through 2030) is a candidate, but it explicitly excludes AI projects unless they already serve over 1M users. Aimparency would have to be framed as an open planning/productivity tool with the agent layer secondary, which is a framing decision for Felix. CodeSupply Fund (software supply-chain security metadata) does not fit. Prototype Fund: the official site returned 403 to automated fetches and search only surfaced older rounds, so no verified current deadline. Effectiveness: Verified from official NLnet call pages; Prototype Fund status remains unverified and must be checked by a human in a browser. Lesson: NLnet's general call was replaced by thematic funds with shared deadlines; check each fund's exclusions (here, the AI exclusion) before treating it as an opportunity. Pattern: monthly-funding-scan
